course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Reposting:75 stays 75, changes yield 90 and unposting preserves the other recorder
goal: Verify repeat/replacement/unposting without duplication or losing another recorder.

prerequisites.text: onec.p5; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A repeatable transformation
paragraphs: Posting transforms the current document into a movement set. Identical input should yield an equivalent set regardless of repetition. Compare dimensions, resources, periods and recorder—not merely one total. Opposite duplicates can cancel numerically while leaving invalid records.

Begin with own 30/45 requests totaling 75. Reposting the first is not another 30-minute fact: movements represent current document state rather than button presses. The handler clears and rebuilds its own object’s set.

sections.title: Native worked example
paragraphs: Excerpt only; the complete source below belongs to the stated server common module.

sections.title: A change replaces the prior effect
paragraphs: Changing 30 → 45 replaces the recorder’s old effect under the agreed policy. Appending 45 gives 75 incorrectly. For multiline documents, test a removed line: its old movement must disappear. Define behavior for an empty document too.
Changing the first 30 → 45 replaces its effect, giving 90 rather than 120. Unposting it leaves the second 45; unposting the second leaves 0 for this own customer, without clearing other customers.

sections.title: Failures must not mix versions
paragraphs: Failure between removing old and writing new records must not leave a partial effect. Inject failure only in a new copy and test atomicity. Reread document/register in a fresh session. Transactions and locks address different concerns: one change’s consistency versus interacting concurrent changes.
A parameterized query checks each stage. A correct final 0 could hide an earlier duplication, so retain all five claims:75, 75, 90, 45, 0. Unposting retains document identity.

sections.title: Discriminating semantic control
paragraphs: A compilable wrong value is not a syntax-only test.

sections.title: Use a matrix beyond the happy path
paragraphs: Use post 30, repeat 30, change 45, remove a line, reverse, repost. Record counts and movement identities at every step. Include another recorder to expose accidental deletion of someone else’s set. Preserve both the current invariant and independent earlier documents.

A31/45 negative set gives 76 despite the same count. The initial 75 expectation must detect it. Specify a separate injected posting failure to check atomic old/new state; concurrent posting needs suitable separate sessions and is not established by one file-base experiment.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A helper definition is duplicated inside the startup handler. Keep one module-level helper and only its call inside startup.
Whole-register totals replace the own-key control. Filter by the actual customer/service/recorder reference for this experiment.
A runnable result is treated as proof of all accounting/security behavior. Record each checked mechanism and retain untested concurrency/edition limits.
